# omadafusion_lan_network (Resource)

A gateway-served VLAN network (Network Config > LAN). Creating a network also makes the controller tag it on the built-in `All` port profile and create an access port profile with the same name. Do not manage the DHCP DNS of a network with both this resource and `omadafusion_lan_network_dhcp_dns`. The default (native) network cannot be created or deleted; import it to manage its settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omadafusion_lan_network" "management" { name = "Management" }

# A new VLAN for cameras with its own DHCP pool and public DNS.
resource "omadafusion_lan_network" "cameras" {
  name             = "Cameras"
  vlan             = 60
  gateway_subnet   = "192.168.60.1/24"
  dhcp_start       = "192.168.60.100"
  dhcp_end         = "192.168.60.199"
  dhcp_dns_servers = ["1.1.1.1", "1.0.0.1"]
}

# An internet-only guest network (gateway-enforced isolation).
resource "omadafusion_lan_network" "guest" {
  name           = "Guest"
  vlan           = 40
  gateway_subnet = "192.168.40.1/24"
  isolation      = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gateway_subnet` (String) Gateway address and prefix, e.g. `192.168.30.1/24`.
- `name` (String) Network name.
- `vlan` (Number) VLAN ID, 2-4094 (the default network uses 1).

### Optional

- `dhcp_dns_servers` (List of String) Up to two DNS servers handed out by DHCP. Omit to hand out the gateway (controller `auto` mode).
- `dhcp_enabled` (Boolean) Serve DHCP from the gateway.
- `dhcp_end` (String) Last address of the DHCP pool. Defaults to `.199` of the subnet when DHCP is enabled.
- `dhcp_lease_minutes` (Number) DHCP lease time in minutes.
- `dhcp_start` (String) First address of the DHCP pool. Defaults to `.50` of the subnet when DHCP is enabled.
- `igmp_snooping` (Boolean) Enable IGMP snooping.
- `interface_ids` (List of String) Gateway LAN interfaces that carry the network. Defaults to the interfaces of the default network.
- `isolation` (Boolean) Guest-style isolation: the network can reach the Internet only.
- `site` (String) Site name or ID. Defaults to the provider `site`. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) LAN network ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id> or <site>/<id>
terraform import omadafusion_lan_network.cameras Default/64f0c0ffee00000000000001
```
